abstracted_predicate.name: RECORDS_DURABLE_ARTIFACT_STATE_REFERENCE_FOR_COMPARISON_OR_HISTORY
abstracted_predicate.definition: An action captures an identifiable reference representing the state of one or more target artifacts or an accepted set of changes at the time of recording, such as pre-change fingerprints or a version-control commit of accepted changes, and the resulting observation reports that reference together with the artifacts or change set it covers, thereby providing a recorded basis for later comparison, change detection, or historical retrieval.

parameters.name: recording_action
parameters.description: The action that computes, captures, or commits an identifiable reference representing the current or accepted state of the target artifacts or change set.

parameters.name: reference_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the resulting reference identifier, fingerprint, commit metadata, or equivalent summary and the artifacts or changes to which it applies.

assertion_conditions: The recording action produces an identifiable reference representing the state of at least one target artifact or of an accepted set of changes at the time of recording.
The reference_observation reports the resulting reference, such as an identifier, fingerprint, commit identifier, or equivalent summary, and identifies the artifacts or change set it covers.
The recorded reference is intended or usable for later comparison, change detection, or historical retrieval of the covered artifacts or changes.
exclusion_conditions: The action produces no identifiable reference or recorded representation for the covered artifacts or changes.
The observation only reports that recording was attempted without reporting the resulting reference.
The recorded reference cannot be associated with the artifacts or change set to which it is supposed to apply.
The recorded values serve only an unrelated purpose and cannot support later comparison, change detection, or historical retrieval.
